Product Features

  • Note: This product consists of 2 packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!
  • Stylish and modern design – Elegant size of 80 x 40 x 160 cm, simple lines and glass door with aluminum frame, can be easily integrated into different living styles and enhances the style of the room.
  • Flexible Storage – 4-layer design, fixed middle layer + top and bottom adjustable dividers, freely adapt to different item heights, more efficient storage.
  • Colorful LED Lights – Built-in app-controllable LED light strip, supports switching between tens of millions of colors and creates a romantic, warm, or party atmosphere with one click.
  • Intelligent control experience – adjust light color, brightness and mode remotely via mobile phone app to create a living room atmosphere with comprehensive technology feeling.
  • High-quality chipboard material – cabinet made of high-density chipboard, sturdy, durable and eco-friendly, with strong bearing capacity and will not deform even after long-term use.
  • Transparent glass door design – double-leaf glass doors with aluminum frames are dustproof and moisture-proof, perfect for display and storage, making it easy to find items at a glance.
  • Do-it-yourself customization – the color of the light changes with your mood and can be matched to festivals, seasons, or home themes to create a unique atmosphere.
  • Multifunctional usage scenarios - suitable as a living room display cabinet, bedroom storage cabinet or entrance shoe cabinet, a great tool for expanding the capacity of small apartments.
  • USB Powered – Comes with a 5V 2A USB cable (USB plug not included) that can be connected to your TV, computer, power bank, etc. Safe and easy to use indoors.

Descriptions

Describe

The total size is 80 x 40 x 160 cm. The main material is chipboard. The two doors are glass doors with aluminum frames. The interior is divided into 4 layers. The middle level is a solid floor. The upper and lower dividers can be adjusted according to the size of the items. It is equipped with LED light strips and is controlled by a mobile phone app. You can design thousands of colors as you wish to create a homely atmosphere. Two packages, please note delivery time.
